mapper.sql: SELECT CONCAT( COALESCE(material_id, ''), ':', COALESCE(CAST(warehouse_id AS CHAR), ''), ':', COALESCE(project_id, '') ) AS uuid, material_id AS materialId, material_code AS materialCode, material_name AS materialName, model, brand, category AS businessCategory, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, MAX(w.warehouse_name) AS warehouseName, project_id AS projectId, MAX(p.project_name) AS projectName, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) AS inboundQuantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'OUT' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) AS outboundQuantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END), 2) AS balanceQuantity, MAX(txn_time) AS lastTxnTime FROM goods_transaction_dynamic_info gtdi LEFT JOIN warehouse_info w ON w.id = gtdi.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN project_basic_info p ON p.uuid = gtdi.project_id GROUP BY material_id, material_code, material_name, model, brand, category, warehouse_id, project_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY material_code ASC, warehouse_id ASC, project_id ASC
